$comment: WU-11 scored-run EXECUTION policy. NOT part of the frozen config (this file lives OUTSIDE benchmarks/study/spec/ so it is not in FROZEN_PATHS) -- it is a run parameter, like --reps / --threads / --cell-timeout, disclosed via git + environment.json at run time. Set 2026-07-09 (leafblower-2ouc.36) from the WU-REH honest probes.
time_budget_rationale: Uniform disclosed wall-clock ceiling applied to EVERY solver x problem cell (fairness). Exceeding it => status='dnf' (right-censored did-not-finish; the driver records a real dnf row, it is NOT dropped). Sized from the honest probes: a single osqp solve of the 1.58M stepstone cell takes 76s (well-conditioned) / 324s (tight/ill); sbw's documented bal_alg=TRUE grid is ~8x that (~10min / ~43min); leafblower/oris finish in ~12-35s. 3600s (60min) leaves headroom for the slowest legitimate run while bounding total matrix wall-clock; any cell still running at 3600s is genuinely pathological and is honestly right-censored, not truncated silently.

structural_infeasibility_policy.rule: A cell is STRUCTURALLY INFEASIBLE when any margin declares a target category with target>0 but ZERO sample observations carry it (no reweighting can reach a positive target on an empty category). Extreme-skew/high-cardinality small-n instances realize only a subset of the declared categories.
structural_infeasibility_policy.handling: UNIVERSAL driver precheck (run_arm.{R,py}, non-frozen): detected on the materialized post-subsample problem BEFORE any solver runs; EVERY solver -- competitors AND leafblower -- records a single status='infeasible' row (converged=false, wall_time_s=0, length-1 NaN-sentinel weights_ref), the solver is NOT invoked. Apples-to-apples: the head-to-head speed/quality comparison runs on FEASIBLE cells only; infeasible cells are a separate detection/robustness sub-analysis.
structural_infeasibility_policy.rationale: Set 2026-07-10 (WU-REH v8 amendment). The reps=1 rehearsal surfaced phantom-based competitors (R sbw/optweight/ebal/weightit) crashing with ungraceful matrix/rbind errors and Python svy/ipfn crashing (ValueError/AttributeError) on these cells, while leafblower_logit already classified them INFEAS. A per-adapter crash label would misrepresent an objectively-infeasible cell as a solver defect. The universal precheck classifies uniformly (user decision: match leafblower, both arms, all solvers).
structural_infeasibility_policy.note: 'infeasible' is a pre-existing status_enum value (no schema change). Distinct from 'dnf' (right-censored timeout) and 'bad_arg' (adapter/dispatch refusal, e.g. multi-objective-family meta-packages).

memory_gate.policy: Some solver x big-n cells have a large peak RSS and MUST NOT be co-scheduled (the box has 60 GB). The WU-11 launcher shards cells across CPU cores (the driver itself is serial; parallelism is external, e.g. xargs -P). A cell whose rehearsal-measured peak_rss_bytes exceeds 0.5*total_ram runs at concurrency 1 (no co-scheduling with any other heavy cell); light cells run at default_concurrency. Enforced by the launcher reading each (solver,problem) cell's peak_rss_bytes from the WU-REH rehearsal runs.parquet.

suspected_heavy_unmeasured.note: same QP/KKT-factorization class as sbw; peak RSS not yet measured -- WU-11 must measure and gate by the same rule, do NOT assume light.
